prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. PRODUCTION REFERENCE SHEET, landscape, not a finished book page. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
WD-KIT / Kit: six-year-old human boy, golden light-medium skin, short straight black side-parted hair, teal T-shirt, mustard shorts, navy sneakers. WD-ZOE / Zoe: six-year-old human girl, deep brown skin, black hair in two puffs, yellow T-shirt, plum overalls, white sneakers. Kit and Zoe have equal standing height. Include only characters needed by this exact scene, not every reference pose. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: Island or Peninsula?; World Discovery; nonfiction.
Setting: A classroom low table with a shallow blue rectangular water tray; brown modeling clay represents land. Daylight; Kit and Zoe watch from opposite long edges.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): Shallow blue tray with a thin layer of water; Brown clay mainland fixed along left tray edge; Rounded clay lobe connected by narrow strip; Small yellow toy person; Blunt wooden modeling stick
 Create a clean separated reference board on white: show the principal recurring props/animals in front, side and three-quarter views, their relative scale beside any named human cast, and a single simple location key showing the persistent setting and daylight/palette. The human character model sheet is a supporting identity reference, not content to copy wholesale. Show only the subjects this book requires. Use initial object states: Water on three sides of lobe; narrow connecting strip above water.. For orientation, the opening location/action is: Kit and Zoe lean over a blue tray containing a rounded clay lobe connected to clay mainland on the left. Exact continuity: Water on three sides of lobe; narrow connecting strip above water.. Do not show a completed craft or later scene merely because the finished object is listed in design locks. No future story events, no captions. Clay land has ONE mainland on LEFT edge, ONE rounded lobe to its RIGHT, connected by a narrow exposed clay neck. Blue water surrounds lobe on upper/right/lower sides. Do not place the toy in the water.

visualReview.note: Direct inspection: blue shallow tray, brown mainland at left linked by narrow dry neck to rounded right lobe, water on three sides; yellow toy person and blunt wood tool separated. Cast identity matches; reference composition is design-only, final scenes must honor opposite table edges.
visualReview.limits: Direct agent image/sequence inspection; not physical classroom observation.
